overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly focused social media presence across academic and professional platforms (LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon) with a total audience of 3,580 followers. His content consistently centers around computational social science, disinformation detection, tool releases, and recruitment, driving high engagement rates relative to audience size across all channels.

contentThemes.description: Posts focused on detecting coordinated inauthentic behavior, link sharing analysis, and platform methodologies.
Announcements regarding research grants, published papers, conference presentations, and software updates (CooRnet).
Call-outs for hiring postdoctoral researchers and inviting PhD students to explore research opportunities.

recommendations: Cross-promote major milestones (such as tool releases and grants) simultaneously across all three platforms to maximize reach.
Increase interactive elements on LinkedIn (e.g., questions, links, or visual assets) to convert high follower count into higher relative engagement.
Leverage Bluesky's high amplification rate (reposts) for recruiting candidates and expanding open-access research visibility.
Include visual media or link previews in Mastodon posts to increase interaction rates on technical updates.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest engagement rate (avg ~6.14%) with strong virality via reposts, making it the most effective channel for spreading research calls and paper announcements.
platformInsights.mastodon: Niche, highly technical audience responsive to tool releases like CooRnet v2.0, yielding solid baseline engagement despite a smaller follower base.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest follower base (1,850) driving the highest absolute number of likes and comments, proving optimal for professional announcements, grant wins, and hiring.
